item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a 2024 source showing Hasina herself publicly admitting an error, retracting a false claim, or materially correcting misinformation when correction would have protected her reputation or power. The only counterevidence is weak: one disputed attribution around a U.S.-role claim and one post-hoc probe request after she had already fled.
